description: This file contains implementation and initialization logic for trigger shape handling in an engine control project, including class definitions, methods for managing trigger events, shape configuration, and synchronization, as well as includes of external trigger-specific modules.

classes.name: trigger_shape_helper
classes.description: Helper class to manage trigger shape pin states and channels.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: Main class representing the shape of trigger signals, managing trigger event data, synchronization, and shape configuration.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the trigger shape definition.

methods.name: getCycleDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration (in degrees) of one trigger cycle based on operation mode.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a trigger event at a specified angle, with logic for handling insertion, duplication, and state management.

methods.name: initializeTriggerShape
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape based on provided trigger configuration, including specific shape initialization functions.

methods.name: findAngleIndex
methods.description: Performs binary search to find the index of a given target angle within trigger events.

methods.name: findTriggerPosition
methods.description: Determines the position of a trigger event relative to an angle offset, considering TDC and global offsets.
